text: 周五（9月4日）欧市尾盘，英国10年期国债收益率跌0.1个基点，报5.133%，北京时间20:30发布美国非农就业报告时从5.130%拉升自豪5.184%，本周累计上涨10.3个基点，9月1日显著高开、2-4日持续回撤。 两年期英债收益率涨1.2个基点，报4.531%，非农就业报告出炉时从日低4.513%附近拉升至4.575%，本周累涨17.3个基点。 本周，30年期英债收益率累涨1.6个基点，50年期英债收益率累涨1.1个基点。 2/10年期英债收益率利差累跌6.986个基点，报+60.211个基点。
text_en: Friday (Sept. 4) European session tail end: UK 10-year gilt yield fell 0.1 basis point to 5.133%, jumping from 5.130% to 5.184% at 20:30 Beijing time when U.S. nonfarm payrolls were released, up 10.3 bps on the week, with a notable gap higher on Sept. 1 and sustained pullbacks on Sept. 2-4. Two-year gilt yield rose 1.2 bps to 4.531%, climbing from around 4.513% daily low to 4.575% upon the payrolls release, up 17.3 bps on the week. This week, the 30-year gilt yield rose 1.6 bps and the 50-year rose 1.1 bps. The 2/10-year gilt yield spread fell 6.986 bps to +60.211 bps.
